delivery.computer: Real AWS nonprod Developer Computer with persistent encrypted home
delivery.access: Create an account on the app. Regression accounts and records were removed by the operator.
delivery.earlierPreviews: The first nine were verified while running, then their completed sessions were stopped to reuse the same Computer.

fixes.change: Explicit existing mode subscribes to Gemini only and refuses the Hannibal/provisioning path before any Computer run.
fixes.validation: Gemini-only setup, mode mismatch and invalid operator-mode regressions pass; all ten live preparations select existing-postgres-gemini.

fixes.gap: A shared external database needs project isolation and explicit network approval
fixes.change: Strict TLS, exact database/pooler project binding, a restricted role and three owned schemas; a separate API gate admits only approved provider hosts and public Supabase address pins.
fixes.validation: API 29 and worker 128 checks pass; exact worker modules deployed with hashes/backups, ten restricted-role real Computer builds and public flows passed, and actual signed network lease expiry/reconnect passed.

fixes.gap: Different project names could normalize or truncate to the same database schemas
fixes.change: Existing-database projects use a SHA-256-derived database namespace.
fixes.validation: Two namespace regressions pass; all 39 manifest-owned schemas across ten projects and three retained failed attempts have distinct expected owners and markers; original 41 protected tables and eight schema ACLs are unchanged after operator-only cleanup.

fixes.gap: Impossible calendar dates and duplicate dropdown choices were accepted
fixes.change: Date values must round-trip as the same ISO calendar date; choice values must be unique.
fixes.validation: Two failures reproduced before the fixes; boundary regressions now pass and preserve zero and false.

fixes.gap: A live PRD review treated explicitly excluded features as requirements
fixes.change: Reader guidance distinguishes required, excluded and deferred scope, including conflicting later explicit requirements.
fixes.validation: Study Journal retest has no unsupported requirements; Personal Event Checklist correctly flags both permissions and reminder emails, then removes them only after an explicit human deferral.

fixes.gap: The agent claimed to discard an unreadable draft without settling it
fixes.change: Explicit cancellation must call the draft tool and confirm persistence; unreadable drafts retain their filenames.
fixes.validation: Three new lifecycle checks pass. Live scanned-PDF cancellation, readable replacement and final discard passed.

fixes.gap: Later human project/theme clarifications were discarded by a source-only check
fixes.change: Setup-choice validation now considers both the original document and the retained human clarifications.
fixes.validation: Failure reproduced before the fix; the regression and the live later-theme-override case pass.

fixes.gap: A reader changed an explicitly provided field label
fixes.change: Reader guidance preserves identifiers, labels, field types and choice values exactly.
fixes.validation: All ten final live blueprints match their fixture collections and fields exactly.

fixes.gap: An opaque encoded identifier appeared in an earlier native reply
fixes.change: Builder guidance explicitly avoids copying opaque historical prefixes.
fixes.validation: No encoded UUID prefix in the earlier 31 native retest replies or the ten full conversational flows. The original upstream-generation cause was not established; this is a verified prompt-level mitigation.
